verdict: ROAS held strong this period, but purchase momentum has stalled this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5,481.08 in revenue on $1,480.42 in spend — a 3.7 return on ad spend — with 34 purchases across 815 clicks. That 28-day picture is solid, but the last seven days showed a 14.29% drop in purchases and a 2.86% dip in return on ad spend, driven in part by a 15.55% compression in Instagram reach that is pulling conversion momentum down. Ad creative is being refreshed to address the reach and engagement decline, and the on-site conversion path is being reviewed to close the gap between steady site traffic and the purchase stall seen in the last three days. You should expect cleaner conversion data and refreshed creative in market by next week's report.
